explanation: Parametrize counterclockwise by r(t) = (√2 cos(t), 2√2 sin(t)), 0 ≤ t ≤ 2π. Then 2xy = 8cos(t)sin(t) = 4sin(2t), and ds = √(2sin²(t)+8cos²(t)) dt = √(6cos²(t)+2) dt. This gives b directly. All displayed integrals also equal zero by reflection symmetry, so they are numerically equivalent; b matches the direct substitution.
